newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Finance Ministry wants De Beers deal-Tass.
newsitem.headline: Russian Finance Ministry wants De Beers deal-Tass.

text.p: Russia's official Itar-Tass news agency quoted an unidentified Finance Ministry official as saying on Wednesday that Moscow was ready to continue working with De Beers.
But it also quoted the official as having said that a De Beers announcement giving Russia until the end of the year to sign a formal trade agreement was "indadequate".
The official said the ministry had not received De Beers' announcement.

The South African gem group gave the Russian government until December 31 to sign a formal diamond trade deal allowing Russia to export gems and said that otherwise it would terminate an interim agreement.
The Finance Ministry is one of the government organisations responsible for approving the final deal.
Finance Minister Alexander Livshits told Russian news agencies on Tuesday that Moscow wanted to rework the deal before signing it.
De Beers said it had had no official word from the government since it submitted the trade agreement in October.
